units.source_text: 这一天给我留下了极其暗淡的印象，

en.t: That day left an extremely gloomy impression on me,

units.source_text: 我们的郊游凄楚地结束了固然是原因之一，但又不仅仅缘于此。

en.t: one reason was certainly that our outing had ended so sadly, but that was not all there was to it.

units.source_text: 东京方面给老师发来了一封电报，

en.t: a telegram arrived for the master from Tokyo,

units.source_text: 老师旋即向全寺庙的人宣布了电报的内容。

en.t: and the master immediately announced its contents to everyone in the temple.
